title: Telerik UI for WinForms documentation accessibility audit

included: Markdown article structure, prose, links, tables, code presentation, callouts, and embedded content.
Text alternatives and contextual explanations for documentation assets referenced by articles.
excluded: Telerik WinForms runtime behavior and product accessibility capabilities.
Report, viewer, designer, or generated-report accessibility.
Product keyboard navigation, product screen reader support, and accuracy of product accessibility claims.
scope.changes: This deliverable records findings and recommendations only; it does not change articles, assets, rendering templates, or product code.

approach: Inventory tracked .md files at the source commit using git ls-files '*.md'.
Scan all 3,116 article candidates across every content directory; exclude .github/**, _assetsApi/**, and README.md from article counts. Review README.md separately for contributor guidance.
Remove initial YAML front matter and skip fenced code before collecting source-pattern indicators. Track backtick and tilde fence lengths; ignore indented code when scanning non-fence content.
Collect ATX heading transitions, inline Markdown images, exact image-alt/basename matches, generic inline link labels, fenced code language labels, iframe tags, and literal <snippet inclusion lines.

Supplement the scan with pipe-table separator and empty-cell candidates, HTML table tags, same-line nested tables, designated and alternative callout markers, color/spatial vocabulary, and bare prose URLs. Mask inline code with a nonempty token for these supplemental checks so code-valued cells are not miscounted as empty.
Manually inspect candidate passages and surrounding content before recording detailed findings. Counts are search indicators, not independently confirmed violations for every matching article.
Apply the authoritative skill's eight weighted dimensions to representative articles. Keep severity, which describes user impact and remediation priority, separate from the numerical article score.
Supplement the skill with the requested embedded-media and screenshot-context checks, without changing its eight scoring weights.
limitations: This is a repository-wide source-pattern survey with targeted manual review, not a line-by-line human audit of all 3,116 articles or a WCAG conformance certification.
The inventory includes tracked article candidates regardless of published front matter; it does not claim all candidates appear on the live site.

Pattern matching is not a full Markdown or Liquid parser. Reference-style images and links, multiline HTML, inline code, escaped syntax, Setext headings, and custom components require additional review.
Missing source H1 headings do not prove missing rendered page titles. Knowledge-base templates may inject a title; verify the generated outline before adding another H1.
No rendered-site, browser accessibility-tree, keyboard, screen reader, reflow, contrast, or documentation-player interaction testing was performed.
External snippet bodies are not available in this checkout. Only their inclusion syntax and surrounding authoring context were inspected.
Remote video captions, transcripts, audio descriptions, and player behavior were not inspected. A missing transcript link in Markdown is not proof that the remote video has no captions.
Only the weighted-average screenshot was visually inspected. Other asset findings concern their source alternatives and surrounding prose, not a claim that every visual detail was inspected.
Flesch-Kincaid readability was not calculated; plain-language findings are editorial observations with quoted examples, not measured reading-grade results.
A category with no confirmed finding is not certified accessible. In particular, decorative-image intent and rendered landmark semantics need follow-up.
The checked-in skill defines article scoring, not a corpus-scanning implementation. The source-pattern inventory is an audit-specific survey, and plain-language assessment remains manual.

severity_definitions.Critical: A verified, widespread barrier prevents understanding of essential documentation content.
severity_definitions.High: A significant documentation accessibility barrier requiring near-term remediation.
severity_definitions.Medium: Reduced accessibility or usability to address during regular maintenance.
severity_definitions.Low: A localized consistency or best-practice improvement.

methodology.scoring_policy: Use scores from 1 to 5 and round the weighted sum to one decimal place. A 5 for a dimension whose construct is absent means no violation observed in that article, not proof of renderer support. Do not extrapolate these purposively selected article scores into a repository average.

Executive Summary.assessment: Documentation accessibility is inconsistent at the source-authoring level. Many articles have useful headings, prose instructions, language-labeled examples, and named callouts, but recurring legacy patterns reduce nonvisual navigation and access to visual examples.
main_risk_areas: Screenshot alternatives that identify a file or topic instead of conveying the demonstrated result.
Nested or layout-only tables that obscure reading order and cell relationships.
Repeated top-level related-links headings and skipped section levels.
Generic link labels and media without clearly linked text alternatives.
Long examples without a navigable reading guide and inconsistent semantic callouts.
most_common_observed_patterns: 1,626 article candidates contain an H1 labeled See Also.
994 article candidates contain at least one source ATX heading-level jump.
273 article candidates contain one of the scanned generic link labels.
158 article candidates contain image alt text exactly equal to the referenced image basename.
Executive Summary.estimated_content_quality_maturity: Developing: the repository has established metadata, reusable includes, callout conventions, and contributor instructions, but the reviewed guidance does not turn documentation accessibility into explicit acceptance checks. This is a qualitative source-authoring assessment, not a measured organizational maturity level.
Executive Summary.critical_findings: No Critical finding established. The audit found significant recurring barriers, but did not demonstrate widespread inability to understand essential content sufficient to justify that severity.

positive_examples.observation: Screenshots are accompanied by captions, action-oriented prose, and descriptions naming the selected template or installed package.
Both embedded videos already have descriptive iframe titles and introductory text; retain these while adding text-alternative discovery.
The member table has descriptive column headers, a lead-in, populated cells, and a complete important callout.

immediate_actions: Flatten the manifest settings table into one setting/state/mode combination per row and label the currently empty header.
Replace the screenshot layout table with separately labeled figures and a textual comparison.
Repair the H1-to-H3 jump and demote See Also; replace generic link labels.

Immediate Action Required.risks: The environment table has no header cells; the source outline skips levels and has no article H1.
immediate_actions: Use a simple Field/Value table or a definition list for environment metadata.
Verify whether the page template supplies the H1; change the H4 example heading to an H3 under Description.

Immediate Action Required.risks: Repeated Read more labels lead to distinct destinations; a video layout table has inconsistent column counts.
immediate_actions: Replace repeated Read more labels with the relevant feature or task name.
Replace the video layout table with a descriptive link, summary, and verified text alternative.

Immediate Action Required.risks: A video-and-thumbnail layout table has an empty header; screenshot alternatives are file identifiers; empty/skipped headings and generic links impede navigation.
immediate_actions: Convert Related videos to a named link with a summary and discoverable text alternative.
Describe each screenshot's purpose; remove the empty heading and repair the code-section outline.
Expand SVG, VS, and DLL at first use and turn the escaped priority numbering into a real ordered list.

Immediate Action Required.risks: The embedded video has no source title, a feed example has no language label, and an operational reminder uses an untyped quote.
immediate_actions: Give the iframe a descriptive title and introduce the video as optional alongside the written installation steps.
Label the feed block text and convert the expiration reminder to the designated important callout syntax.

Immediate Action Required.risks: A filename-style alternative omits the screenshot's numerical result; lengthy bilingual code blocks lack a section-by-section guide.
immediate_actions: Describe the demonstrated totals in nearby text, including Sum(A)=14, Sum(B)=20, and the total ratio 0.70.
Add navigable subsections or a reading guide for data setup, calculated fields, and aggregation.

Immediate Action Required.risks: Two long file-identifier alternatives conceal the before/after purpose, a generic link obscures its destination, and an empty note marker disrupts callout structure.
immediate_actions: Name the Hidden and Visible property states in the alternatives.
Use Property Precedence Rules as link text and remove the empty note marker.

immediate_actions: Map each module to its transcript or equivalent written tutorial and explain how to find verified captions.

immediate_actions: Remove the empty heading or replace it with a descriptive section name.

Detailed Findings.category: Table accessibility: nested data and empty headers
Detailed Findings.impact: State values and their corresponding mode names occupy separate nested tables. Linear reading requires readers to remember positional relationships; the setting column has no name and bold setting names are not row headers.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Use a flat table with Setting, Minimum supported OS, State, and DPI mode columns; repeat the setting and OS for each state/mode pair. Retain the existing lead-in and remove the empty row. If HTML remains necessary, use explicit header cells and scope.
Detailed Findings.example_correction:
| Setting | Minimum supported OS | State | DPI mode |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| dpiAware | Windows Vista | false | Unaware |
| dpiAware | Windows Vista | true | System aware |

Detailed Findings.category: Table accessibility: screenshot layout and visual comparison

evidence.quote: You can notice that the first image becomes blurry on 200% scaling, while the second one remains crisp and looks modern.

Detailed Findings.impact: The one-column table contains two screenshots rather than comparative data. The alternatives name DPI support but do not distinguish the blurry and crisp examples; the prose depends on first/second visual ordering.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Present labeled figures outside a table. Describe the demonstrated difference in text and use the same labels in the alternatives; do not make perceiving sharpness a prerequisite to understanding the comparison.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: Comparison at 3840 × 2160 and 200% scaling: Example A demonstrates blurred bitmap-scaled text; Example B demonstrates crisp text. Label the corresponding images Example A and Example B.

Detailed Findings.category: Table accessibility: metadata without header cells
Detailed Findings.impact: All environment cells use td, so the source provides no header associations for Product Version, Product, or Author. Table navigation cannot rely on semantic label/value relationships.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Prefer a definition list or bullet list for short metadata. If retaining a table, supply Field and Value column headers, or mark each label as th scope="row" in HTML.
Detailed Findings.example_correction:
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Product Version | 2018.3.1016 |
| Product | RadGridView for WinForms |

Detailed Findings.category: Table accessibility: related-video layout
Detailed Findings.impact: A video link and thumbnail are positioned using table cells with an empty column header. This adds a meaningless table-navigation structure and an unhelpful image announcement.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Use a Related videos section with a descriptive video link, a summary, and a transcript or equivalent written lesson. Remove an unnecessary thumbnail; mark it decorative only after confirming that its information is fully duplicated in text.
Detailed Findings.example_correction:
## Related videos

[Applying themes at the control and form level](http://tv.telerik.com/watch/winforms/themes/radcontrols-winforms-theme) demonstrates the theme selection workflow. Add a verified transcript or equivalent written walkthrough link.

Detailed Findings.category: Heading structure: skipped levels and multiple top-level sections
Detailed Findings.impact: The outline moves directly from the article title to H3 or H4, and related links create a second H1. Heading-list navigation no longer reflects a consistent article/section hierarchy.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Keep one article H1, use H2 for these main sections and See Also, and adjust subordinate headings without breaking existing fragment links.
Detailed Findings.example_correction:
## DPI awareness

## See Also

Detailed Findings.category: Heading structure: missing source title and skipped example level
Detailed Findings.impact: Neither article has a source H1, and the knowledge-base example moves from H2 Description to H4. A source reader lacks the expected title-level entry point; the rendered H1 status remains unverified.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Confirm the title-rendering contract per article type before adding an H1. Ensure exactly one rendered article H1 and change the example under Description to H3; avoid mass insertion of titles into knowledge-base pages.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: ### Access the elements by index

Detailed Findings.category: Heading structure: empty and presentation-only headings

evidence.quote: #### Setting a default theme for the entire application
#### WinForms AIPrompt component bridges the gap between an app and the next-generation AI language model applications.

Detailed Findings.impact: Empty headings have no accessible label. The AIPrompt promotional sentence is styled as H4 directly after H1, and the theme example skips H3; both misuse structural levels for presentation.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Remove empty headings or name genuine sections, turn the promotional sentence into ordinary prose, and use sequential levels for example sections.
Detailed Findings.example_correction:
# WinForms AIPrompt Overview

The WinForms AIPrompt component connects an application to an AI language model.

Detailed Findings.category: Alternative text quality: file identifiers instead of image purpose
Detailed Findings.impact: Screen readers announce long hyphenated identifiers without explaining the selected state, action, or visual result. Nearby captions provide some context but do not make the identifiers useful alternatives.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Inspect each screenshot and describe its purpose in context, complementing rather than repeating the caption. Preserve essential settings and results in prose; do not generate alternatives by replacing hyphens in filenames.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: For the precedence example, describe the documented before/after states: 'BorderPrimitive Visibility is Hidden before overriding the default' and 'BorderPrimitive Visibility is Visible after overriding the default'. Verify these descriptions against the assets before applying them.

Detailed Findings.category: Alternative text quality: numerical screenshot result unavailable in text
Detailed Findings.asset_observation: The inspected screenshot shows a GrandTotal row with total Sum of A 14, total Sum of B 20, and Total Sum(A)/Sum(B) of MyCalculatedField 0.70.
Detailed Findings.impact: The prose states the formula, but the file-identifier alternative does not convey the screenshot's demonstrated result. Readers unable to see the image cannot compare their output with that example.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Add concise purpose-based alt text and a nearby textual result summary. If individual illustrated values are important, supply a small data table; do not imply that the randomized example always produces these exact numbers.
Detailed Findings.example_correction:
![Pivot table with the calculated Sum(A)/Sum(B) field](images/add-weighted-average-in-pivotgrid001.png)

In the illustrated data, the grand totals are A = 14 and B = 20, so the total calculated ratio is 14 / 20 = 0.70. Your generated data can differ.

Detailed Findings.category: Link text clarity: identical labels with different destinations
Detailed Findings.impact: The same ICollection label leads to two different interface paths, one labeled IEnumerable elsewhere in the article. A links list does not reliably communicate the destination.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Make the interface label match the intended destination and use a consistent label for each destination. Verify the replacement destination during remediation; this finding does not assert remote link availability.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: [ICollection](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/system.collections.icollection.aspx)

Detailed Findings.category: Link text clarity: generic destination labels
Detailed Findings.impact: Here and this article do not identify their destinations in a screen reader links list. Surrounding sentences sometimes provide context, so this is not a claim that every occurrence necessarily fails WCAG 2.4.4.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Move the meaningful topic or action into the link text. Preserve slug syntax and destination behavior; normalize repeated labels only after resolving equivalent URLs and slugs.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: More information is available in [Vector Images]({%slug winforms-tpf-vector-images%}).

Detailed Findings.category: Embedded content: unnamed video frame
Detailed Findings.impact: The source supplies neither a title nor another frame-naming attribute. Assistive technology users may encounter an unnamed frame before the article introduction; a renderer-supplied name was not verified.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Add a concise title identifying the video, put an introduction before the frame, and explicitly link the existing written installation steps as the non-video path. Verify whether those steps cover the video's substantive instructions; add a transcript or missing explanation if not.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: Introduce the optional installation video, then add title="Install Telerik UI for WinForms using NuGet packages" to the existing iframe. Link readers to the written installation sections on the same page.

Detailed Findings.category: Code block accessibility: absent language labels
Detailed Findings.impact: Language-aware tools and readers cannot distinguish shell commands, XML, and literal text from fence metadata. The commands have surrounding instructions, so these are not findings of entirely unexplained code.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Use xml for PackageReference, text for a literal URL, and an appropriate shell tag after identifying the intended shell in prose. Retain list indentation and explain expected results where they are not already described.
Detailed Findings.example_correction:
```xml
<PackageReference Include="Telerik.UI.for.WinForms.AllControls" Version="*" />
```

Detailed Findings.category: Code block accessibility: long examples without a reading guide
Detailed Findings.impact: The C# and VB.NET blocks span approximately 150 and 135 lines respectively. Introductory prose explains the concept, but readers must traverse complete setup and helper classes to locate the relevant accumulation and result calculation.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Keep a complete copyable example, but precede it with a short reading guide or split it into labeled, explained stages: sample data, calculated field registration, accumulation, merging, and final ratio. Explain the expected outcome in prose without requiring syntax color.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: Read the example in three parts: create the sample data and register the calculated field; accumulate and merge A and B in MyAggregateValue; return their ratio from GetValueOverride. Link these labels to real subsections if the example is split.

Detailed Findings.category: Embedded content: text alternatives are not discoverable from the article

evidence.quote: The [Telerik UI for WinForms technical online training](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLvmaC-XMqeBYZUfnE5_lSGtGAsEynVL4C) has an approximate duration of 2 hours

Detailed Findings.impact: The source has summaries, a playlist, and module labels but no transcript links or equivalent written-lesson mapping. Readers who cannot consume audiovisual content cannot identify an equivalent path from this article.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Add a transcript or equivalent written tutorial link for each module and each overview video. Verify captions and essential visual descriptions on the remote media, then document where readers can find them; do not claim they are absent without checking.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: For each chapter, list the video title, duration, transcript link, and equivalent written tutorial. Use actual verified destinations rather than placeholder links.

Detailed Findings.category: Callout structure: empty marker

evidence.quote:
>note When we set the Visibility property to Visible, we override the default value and the repository item colors become visible.
>note

Detailed Findings.impact: An empty note marker follows a complete note, leaving the intended callout boundary ambiguous for source readers and custom rendering.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Remove the empty marker and stray quote line. Keep the existing self-contained note and make the general explanation a separate paragraph or a complete continuation using supported syntax.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: >note Setting Visibility to Visible overrides the default value and makes the repository item colors visible.

Detailed Findings.category: Callout structure: operational reminder presented as an untyped quote
Detailed Findings.impact: An account-maintenance reminder is expressed as a generic blockquote rather than the designated note/important pattern used elsewhere on the page. Its semantic type is not explicit in the source.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Use the platform's important callout syntax with a complete action-oriented sentence. Preserve the existing technical information without assessing its correctness.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: >important API keys expire after two years. Set a renewal reminder and record where each key is used.

Detailed Findings.category: Content accessibility: diagram-dependent spatial and color references

evidence.quote: This means that only the area denoted by the rightmost hatched pattern is clipped. The area left visible is fully within the parent rectangle and is denoted by the thick light green line.

Detailed Findings.impact: The article already states the general clipping rule, but these explanatory sentences identify specific diagram regions by position and appearance. The alternative names the overall diagram without giving equivalent region relationships.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Explain the relationship in text before optionally mentioning the visual markers. Expand WPF at first use or link to a definition. This is a prose/diagram-equivalence issue, not a finding about clipping behavior.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: The portion of the child outside the parent rectangle is clipped; the portion inside the parent rectangle remains visible. In the diagram, hatching marks the clipped region and a thick line marks the visible boundary.

Detailed Findings.category: Plain language: unexplained abbreviations
Detailed Findings.impact: Abbreviations are used without first-use expansions, increasing cognitive load for readers unfamiliar with the terminology. Familiarity should not be assumed merely because an article is technical.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Expand abbreviations on first use and link specialized concepts to a glossary when helpful. Keep identifiers intact and do not expand acronyms mechanically inside code.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: Use Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG), Visual Studio (VS), dynamic-link library (DLL), service-level objective (SLO), and Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) at first mention.

Detailed Findings.category: Repository authoring guidance: accessibility checks are not explicit

evidence.quote: When adding content or making changes, please use only standard Markdown syntax
The [documentation Wiki](https://github.com/telerik/winforms-docs/wiki) contains the latest authoring guidelines.

Detailed Findings.impact: The checked-in contributor entry point asks for a visual preview and links to external guidance but does not give explicit accessibility acceptance criteria. The external wiki was not reviewed, so its contents are not characterized as missing.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Add a short, version-controlled accessibility checklist linked to the authoritative skill and the existing authoring guidance. Require meaningful alternatives, logical outlines, descriptive links, simple tables, named callouts, and explained language-tagged code in reviews.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: Before requesting review, check the heading outline, read image alternatives and links out of context, linearize tables, verify media text alternatives, and confirm that examples can be understood without syntax color.

Detailed Findings.category: Link text clarity: repeated generic labels across a feature catalogue
Detailed Findings.impact: A large feature catalogue repeatedly uses the same Read more label for different topics. Link-list navigation cannot distinguish the destinations without returning to each surrounding paragraph; this is more pervasive than an isolated generic link.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Use the feature or linked task as the link label. Keep the introductory feature descriptions, but make each destination independently recognizable. This finding concerns documentation links, not the accessibility of any listed feature.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: [GridView UI virtualization]({%slug winforms/gridview/fundamentals/ui-virtualization%})

Detailed Findings.category: Table accessibility: inconsistent columns in a video layout table

evidence.quote: |[RadGridView for WinForms Webinar](https://www.telerik.com/videos/radgridview-for-winforms-webinar)|This video provides an in-depth overview of Telerik's RadGridView for WinForms|![Telerik UI for WinForms RadGridView webinar thumbnail for the component overview video](images/gridview-overview002.png)|

Detailed Findings.impact: The header and separator have two columns, while the content has three. Besides using a table for layout, the source leaves the thumbnail column without a corresponding header; rendering may discard or otherwise handle the excess cell.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Replace the table with a Related videos section containing the named webinar link and its summary. Include a verified written alternative and omit a redundant thumbnail; do not rely on a particular renderer's recovery of malformed rows.
Detailed Findings.example_correction:
## Related videos

[RadGridView for WinForms Webinar](https://www.telerik.com/videos/radgridview-for-winforms-webinar) provides an in-depth overview. Add a verified transcript or equivalent written overview link.

Detailed Findings.category: Color and formatting independence: visual numbering without list semantics

evidence.quote: 1\. Run **WinAppDriver.exe** as an administrator and leave it running.

Detailed Findings.impact: Escaping the period prevents Markdown from producing an ordered list. The visual sequence remains readable as text, but assistive technology users lose semantic list navigation and item-count information.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Use unescaped ordered-list markers. Keep each step's explanatory prose, screenshots, and examples inside the list item with appropriate indentation; preserve the intended sequence.
Detailed Findings.example_correction:
1. Run **WinAppDriver.exe** as an administrator and leave it running.

   Note its listening address for use in a later step.

Detailed Findings.category: Link text clarity: bare repository URLs
Detailed Findings.impact: Long source URLs are presented without destination-specific labels. If autolinked, they produce cumbersome link announcements; if not, they remain raw text rather than a clearly named example link.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Wrap each repository URL in a label naming the example and distinguish it from the adjacent knowledge-base article link.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: [Negative Area Chart SDK example](https://github.com/telerik/winforms-sdk/tree/master/ChartView/NegativeAreaChart)

Detailed Findings.category: Table accessibility: unexplained empty data cell
Detailed Findings.impact: The SDK Example cell is empty, leaving readers to infer whether an example is unavailable, omitted, or not applicable.
Detailed Findings.recommended_remediation: Determine whether an example should be linked. If none is provided, state that explicitly rather than leaving the cell blank; do not invent a missing destination.
Detailed Findings.example_correction: |[Summary Labels on Stacked Bars]({%slug chartview-summary-labels-stacked-bars%})|No SDK example listed|

source_indicators.pattern: Downward heading jump greater than one level
Image alt exactly equals target basename
Fenced code block without a language label
Iframe without a source title attribute
Pipe-table row with an empty-cell candidate
Multiple HTML table openings on one line
Color or spatial vocabulary candidate line

count_interpretation: Counts are non-additive: the same article can match several indicators, and H1 See Also also includes articles without another H1.
Generic labels matched case-insensitive here, click here, this article, this link, read more, learn more, and more in inline Markdown links.
Image-basename equality is a narrow authoring-smell check, not a complete assessment of alt quality. Topic-only labels can still be insufficient without matching a filename.

No empty inline Markdown image alternatives were found by this scan. This does not establish that all image alternatives are meaningful, all HTML images are accessible, or no decorative alternatives are appropriate.
Potential HTML img matches inside inline code and URL/slug spelling differences were excluded from conclusions about missing alternatives or duplicate destinations.
Language-labeled text prompt blocks count as code fences for the skill's annotation check even when they are not executable.
The 6,340 snippet inclusion lines match literal <snippet tags, not slug links or Liquid includes; they do not represent 6,340 confirmed accessibility violations.

Supplemental table indicators count source lines, not unique tables. Empty-cell candidates require checking actual cell content, and multiple table openings on one line are only a narrow nested-table signal.
An empty callout marker can introduce content on a following line. Review its surrounding block before treating it as an empty admonition.

Designated callout markers match note, tip, important, warning, or caution after >; alternative-label candidates match plain or quoted Note:, Warning:, and Important: forms, including bold variants. Existing caution syntax is not itself a violation.
Color/spatial candidates match red, green, blue, yellow, orange, purple, hatched, rightmost, or leftmost. Named themes and explained color values are not automatically violations.
Bare prose URL candidates are counted after masking inline code, inline Markdown link/image constructs, and HTML tags. Malformed links and literal endpoints can still match, so review is required.

recurring_authoring_issues.pattern: Legacy related-links headings and example-heading levels
recurring_authoring_issues.bulk_remediation: Audit the title-generation contract, then batch-review See Also level changes and heading jumps. Preserve public anchors and check custom code-caption rendering before changing example headings.
recurring_authoring_issues.automation_suitability: High for detection; human or renderer review is required for exceptions and structural corrections.

recurring_authoring_issues.pattern: Filename or topic labels substituted for equivalent image information
recurring_authoring_issues.bulk_remediation: Create a prioritized image-description backlog grouped by article family. Fix instructional and result-bearing figures first; review assets rather than generating alt from names.
recurring_authoring_issues.automation_suitability: Moderate for candidate detection, low for judging informational equivalence or decorative intent.

recurring_authoring_issues.pattern: Legacy metadata, nested tables, and video layout tables
recurring_authoring_issues.bulk_remediation: Replace repeated environment tables with a reviewed accessible pattern; replace Related videos layout tables with lists. Flatten nested data tables case by case.
recurring_authoring_issues.automation_suitability: High for detecting nested tables and absent header cells; semantic restructuring requires review.

recurring_authoring_issues.pattern: Generic links copied into tutorials and callouts
recurring_authoring_issues.bulk_remediation: Replace labels by the linked task or destination, including reusable licensing notices in getting-started articles. Resolve slugs and canonical URLs before comparing destinations.
recurring_authoring_issues.automation_suitability: High for generic-label detection; destination naming and equivalence require context.

recurring_authoring_issues.bulk_remediation: Correct the small unlabeled-fence backlog, then review long examples and the rendered C#/VB snippet tabs. Do not flag external snippet includes as unlabeled Markdown fences.
recurring_authoring_issues.automation_suitability: High for local fence metadata; external snippet output and contextual explanations need integration and manual checks.

recurring_authoring_issues.pattern: Media summaries without discoverable equivalent lessons
recurring_authoring_issues.bulk_remediation: Maintain video-to-transcript/written-lesson mappings and verify existing caption availability before asserting gaps.
recurring_authoring_issues.automation_suitability: High for iframe title presence, moderate for alternative-link presence, low for caption and visual-description quality.

recurring_authoring_issues.pattern: Inconsistent callout boundaries and undefined abbreviations
recurring_authoring_issues.bulk_remediation: Normalize empty or untyped callout markers and introduce a small first-use glossary. Avoid rewriting identifiers and product names.
recurring_authoring_issues.automation_suitability: Moderate; use advisory rules and explicit exceptions rather than blanket rewrites.

Immediate (0-30 days).action: Remediate High findings A01, A03, A04, A12, and A21; repair the associated article outlines and related image descriptions while those articles are open.
Immediate (0-30 days).completion_check: Review the generated table reading order, frame name, article heading list, and text alternatives with assistive technology or equivalent accessibility-tree inspection.

Immediate (0-30 days).action: Verify the three embedded videos' caption/transcript availability and map onboarding lessons to equivalent text. Fill confirmed gaps rather than treating remote media as automatically inaccessible.

accessibility_guidance: Use the authoritative skill's eight dimensions as the review rubric; supplement them with explicit media-alternative and screenshot-equivalence checks.
Treat severity as reader impact, not a direct translation of a rubric score. Record uncertainty about template and external-media behavior.
Teach authors to write the instruction and expected result first, then use an image as supporting evidence rather than the sole information source.
For complex diagrams, use concise alt text plus an adjacent full explanation. For decorative images, use an empty alternative only after confirming they convey no information.
markdown_authoring_standards: Define one rendered article H1 and sequential section levels, with template-specific source rules. Do not use empty headings or headings solely for visual emphasis.
Require destination-specific link labels. Keep names consistent for the same destination, and distinguish downloads, videos, and external resources when relevant.
Use tables only for genuine data relationships. Supply meaningful headers, fill meaningful empty values explicitly, introduce complex data, and avoid nested tables.
Annotate every local fence, introduce its purpose, define placeholders, and explain the expected outcome. Keep long examples navigable and do not depend on syntax color.
Use the documentation platform's supported note, tip, important, warning, or caution conventions consistently. Confirm renderer support rather than blindly replacing existing supported types.
Replace manual checkmarks, spacing, and pseudo-lists with semantic Markdown lists where they express a list. Use names and relationships instead of above/below/left/right or color alone.
Prefer direct imperative steps and short sentences; expand acronyms on first use and link specialized terminology to definitions.
For media, require descriptive frame titles, introductory purpose, discoverable transcripts or equivalent written lessons, and verified captions/visual descriptions as appropriate.
documentation_review_process: Review the heading outline and links list independently of visual layout.
Read an article with images hidden and verify that critical actions, values, and outcomes remain available.
Linearize tables and ensure label/value and state/result relationships still make sense.
Check the generated documentation, including custom snippets, code tabs, callouts, and cards; a generic Markdown preview is not sufficient.
Add periodic assistive technology review of documentation tasks and document exceptions with an owner and rationale.
contributor_instructions: Add a concise accessibility checklist to the checked-in contributor entry point and link to maintained detailed guidance and the scoring skill.
Ask contributors to describe image purpose, expected example outcomes, and media alternatives in review requests.
Provide reviewed examples for standard articles, knowledge-base metadata, complex diagrams, code tabs, and media embeds.
State explicitly that documentation accessibility review does not certify the described product's accessibility.

Automation Opportunities.suggested_tool: A Markdown linter with MD001, MD025, MD041, and MD042-style rules plus a custom empty-heading check.
Automation Opportunities.enforcement: Start with changed-file checks and a documented legacy baseline. Configure H1 rules per renderer/template contract and keep skips within code samples out of heading checks.
Automation Opportunities.human_review: Check intended hierarchy, meaningful labels, rendered title injection, and public-anchor preservation.

Automation Opportunities.suggested_tool: Markdown AST validation plus HTML inspection for missing alternatives; advisory checks for filename-like and generic alt text.
Automation Opportunities.enforcement: Flag absent alt attributes and review empty alternatives against explicitly decorative intent. Keep basename matches advisory; exclude HTML shown as sample code.
Automation Opportunities.human_review: Inspect the actual asset and adjacent text for equivalent information and avoid redundant captions.

Automation Opportunities.suggested_tool: Markdown AST rules for generic labels, URL-only prose links, and repeated label/destination mappings.
Automation Opportunities.enforcement: Normalize slug whitespace and canonical URLs before comparing destinations; exclude image syntax, code, and literal endpoints. Treat alternate labels for one destination as editorial candidates.
Automation Opportunities.human_review: Decide whether each link's purpose is meaningful and whether destination variants are equivalent.

Automation Opportunities.suggested_tool: Markdown table and rendered HTML validation for empty headers, absent th elements, and nested tables.
Automation Opportunities.enforcement: Require reviewed header associations and flag layout-only or excessive-width candidates for review rather than automatically converting data.
Automation Opportunities.human_review: Read tables linearly and confirm that row/column relationships, context, and meaningful empty values remain understandable.

Automation Opportunities.suggested_tool: MD040-style fence-language checks, block-length advisory thresholds, and documentation snippet-build validation.
Automation Opportunities.enforcement: Support three- and four-backtick fences, tilde fences, list indentation, and existing C#/VB.NET/XML tags. Validate generated snippet tabs separately from local fences.
Automation Opportunities.human_review: Check introductions, placeholder descriptions, reading guides, and expected outcomes; line count alone is not an accessibility failure.

Automation Opportunities.suggested_tool: Custom admonition validation and an optional prose linter with a project glossary.
Automation Opportunities.enforcement: Flag empty markers and untyped operational notices. Use advisory checks for long sentences, unexplained abbreviations, and appearance-only references with code and terminology exceptions.
Automation Opportunities.human_review: Choose the correct callout severity and judge whether visual references have a complete textual explanation.

Automation Opportunities.suggested_tool: HTML validation for iframe titles and a maintained media-alternative manifest or equivalent publishing metadata.
Automation Opportunities.enforcement: Require nonempty purpose-specific titles and a discoverable transcript or equivalent written lesson for new instructional media.
Automation Opportunities.human_review: Verify remote caption quality, visual information equivalence, and documentation-player keyboard usability; source text alone cannot establish these.

Automation Opportunities.suggested_tool: Axe-core or an equivalent documentation-page accessibility checker integrated with the actual documentation build.
Automation Opportunities.enforcement: Proposed follow-up only; no new dependencies or CI jobs are introduced by this audit. Scan representative generated pages and changed-page previews, including custom components.
Automation Opportunities.human_review: Use screen readers, keyboard-only reading tasks, zoom/reflow, and contrast checks to validate issues that automation cannot establish.
